acc_balance_note: A running balance becomes derivable once the Income module exists.
acc_desc: Where money actually sits. Shared by expenses and income alike.
acc_empty: No accounts yet. Add the cash or bank account you normally use.
archive_body: History does not change — expenses already recorded against {name} keep pointing at it and are marked archived. You can restore it at any time.
archive_in_use: Still used by {n} records. Archiving does not remove them.
baseline_enough_to_ask: enough to ask about, not necessarily wrong
baseline_no_history: Never recorded in this household before.
baseline_not_enough: Not enough history to compare yet.
baseline_usual: This household usually pays {range} for it.
cal_empty_body: No expenses and no income were logged this month. Step back to a month that has some.
cal_error_body: Nothing is missing from your records — only this view failed.
cal_legend_scale: Each stream is drawn against its own busiest day this month.
cal_partial_body: {n} entries were recorded, past the {limit} a single request returns. A drawn month would be missing days, so it is not drawn. The expense and income ledgers page through them.
cal_partial_title: {month} holds more entries than one view can draw
cal_sheet_foot: Reading only. Entries are changed on the expense and income ledgers.
cal_sheet_none: Nothing was recorded on this day.
cal_sheet_prompt: Pick a day to read what was recorded on it.
cat_desc: What money goes out for. Flat, one level — the expense name carries the detail.
cat_empty: No categories yet. Add the first one so expenses can be grouped.
cat_rim_note: Rim colour follows the order; past eight, colours repeat.
count_slice_partial: More entries than one page holds
deletion_body: Access returns only if it is restored before {date}.
deletion_note: Ask your household admin if you think this is a mistake.
exp_blocked_categories: This household has no expense categories yet.
exp_blocked_sources: This household has no payment sources yet.
expense_delete_body: This removes the entry from the ledger for everyone in the household. Totals for the day and the month change with it. This cannot be undone.
form_blocked_hint: Set this up once and this form works for everyone in the household.
form_description_hint: Optional — what was in the basket.
inc_blocked_sources: This household has no payment sources yet.
inc_blocked_types: This household has no income types yet.
inc_effect_external: Came from outside the household — raises what you hold.
inc_effect_transfer: Household total unchanged — a transfer, not income.
inc_empty_body: Your position above is carried from the month before. The first salary, transfer or gift you log this month will move it.
inc_empty_first: Record this household's first income to get started.
inc_err_same_source: Cannot move money to the same source
inc_form_from_hint: Leave empty when the money came from outside the household
inc_in_note_unknown: Not every entry this month is loaded
income_delete_body: This removes the entry from the statement for everyone in the household, and the balances of the sources it touched change with it. Kept for 7 days before it is really gone.
itype_desc: This household's own words for money coming in. Flat, one level, and in your language, not ours.
itype_note: An archived type stays attached to old entries; it just stops being offered when recording.
itype_presets_body: Pick what fits, or write your own below. These stop appearing once this household has its first type.
land_already_body: That address is already active in another household. Ask them to leave it first, then use a fresh invite.
land_ended_body: Sign in once more to continue. Everything the household recorded is safe.
land_expired_body: It expired or was already used. Ask for a new one — we only need your email.
land_unavailable_body: This household is no longer available. Ask whoever invited you to check on it.
mem_desc: Who is in this household, and what they are allowed to do.
mem_invite_deletion_deadline: This household is scheduled for deletion on {date}.
mem_invite_note: They appear in the list right away, and can join once they click the emailed link.
mem_invite_undelivered: Invite could not be delivered — resend it
mem_leave_admin: You're this household's admin. Promote another member first, or contact support to close the household.
mem_remove_confirm: Remove {name} from {household}? Expenses they recorded stay visible. They can join another household right away.
mem_resend_max: Max resends reached. Remove and re-invite.
mem_status_no_access_long: No access while the household is being deleted
plate_history_kept: History is kept — nothing is destroyed.
pos_down_body: A balance per source needs every income and expense the household ever recorded, so it cannot be worked out in the browser. Waiting on a backend change. The statement below is complete and correct.
pos_empty: No payment sources yet. Add one in Settings so a position can be worked out.
pref_personal_note: This device only. Other members are unaffected.
pref_unavailable: Currency and month start are not available on the server yet. Amounts print in IDR until that route ships.
quote_buffett: Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
quote_ledger: Spend what is left after saving.
quote_proverb: Thrift is the root of wealth.
sent_body: A sign-in link is on its way to {email}. It lasts {n} minutes.
sent_resend_none: No resends left. Try again in an hour.
settings_admin_only: Only admins can change this section.
settings_intro: This household's shared vocabulary. Members can see it; admins change it.
signin_err_network: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signin_err_not_invited: This email isn't in NOSTOS. Ask your household admin to invite you.
signin_err_rate: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
signin_expiry: The link is valid for {n} minutes.
signin_invited_only: Only addresses your household admin has invited can sign in.
signin_lede: Enter your household email. We'll send a single-use link — there's no password to remember.
tape_empty_month_body: Record an expense, or choose another month from the label above the ledger.
